avatars.name: Cartoon (t-shirt)
avatars.prompt: A calm man speaking to the camera with subtle, small mouth movements and a relaxed face; minimal head movement.
avatars.style: Turn this photo of me into a flat 2D cartoon illustration in a retro mid-century adult-animation style: bold clean black outlines, flat cel shading with one shadow tone, limited muted palette, slightly angular stylised features, like a 1960s spy-comic TV cartoon. Keep it clearly recognisable as me: same face, eyes, nose, beard, long dark hair. Make me slightly slimmer. A talking head, head and shoulders, centred, facing the camera and looking into the lens, relaxed and friendly, mouth gently closed (it will be animated to speak), a calm casual look, not dramatic. Setting: a cosy home YouTube studio behind me, softly out of focus: a podcast microphone on a boom arm at the edge of frame, a soft LED panel glow, shelves with a few books and a plant, warm lamp light with teal accent lighting. Wide 16:9 frame with me in the middle third. No text, no logos. Clothes: a plain dark charcoal t-shirt.

voice.instructions: Speak in a neutral, standard British English accent, clear and calm, as a native speaker would, keeping the same voice.

sample.name: my voice sample · 08/11/2026
sample.text:
Hi, I'm Jakub. I make short explainer videos about software, drawn on a dark board with glowing markers.

Each one starts with a single sentence. Then I sketch the idea, point at the parts that matter, and talk you through it, step by step.

Some topics take two minutes; others need ten. Does that sound simple? Mostly, yes. The tricky part is choosing what to leave out, and that's exactly what I'd like to show you today.
